rows.text: The President's press communique dated 13 May 2004 states that Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee has tendered his resignation and that of his colleagues from the Council of Ministers; Deputy Prime Minister L. K. Advani accompanied him.

locator.section: Press Communique, first sentence and closing sentence

rows.text: The same communique states that the President has accepted the resignation.
The same communique states that the President requested Vajpayee and his colleagues to continue in office till alternative arrangements are made.
